description: Management-oriented EOJN KPI model with explicit calendar-aware continuity and review-performance rules.

notes: EOJN raw procurements and notices are expected to cluster around 00:00 local time on working days.
An empty 06:00 run on weekends is not by itself a continuity problem.
Coverage assessment must use both scheduler execution evidence and watermark continuity.

coverage_rules.ok: All expected cycles executed or empty cycles are calendar-normal and watermark continuity is intact.
coverage_rules.warning: At least one expected cycle was missed or failed, but overlap plus watermark continuity still protects against likely raw gaps.
coverage_rules.gap_risk: A required cycle is missing or failed and watermark continuity is stale enough to create a plausible ingest gap.

review_rules.open_review_backlog: Count of canonical tender_latest rows with unresolved decision state.
review_rules.median_review_latency_hours: Median elapsed hours from first strong actionable state to first operator decision.

strong_signal_sla_status.ok: All strong positive signals reviewed within target SLA.
strong_signal_sla_status.warning: Some strong positive signals exceeded target SLA.
strong_signal_sla_status.breach: Majority of strong positive signals exceeded target SLA or remain unresolved.
